name: Biological Data Analysis & Experimental Design
summary: The everyday statistics and programming a working biologist needs to design experiments and analyse lab and field data correctly.

topics.name: Programming for biologists: R or Python basics and data frames
Tidy data, data cleaning and reproducible notebooks
Visualising biological data: good figures and common mistakes
Statistical tests used in biology: t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, non-parametric tests
Linear regression and correlation in biological contexts
Curve fitting: dose-response, enzyme kinetics and growth curves
Multiple testing and false discovery rate
